# Business portrait

## Major organizational type and user layer

### Major organizational type

#### Type A: Growing-up manufacturing and equipment enterprises

| Classification of information | Specific content |
| --- | --- |
| Organisational characteristics | Some 50-500 people, multi-sectoral, multi-silo, multi-sKU; |
| Organisational characteristics | (a) The interaction between sales, procurement, inventory, production and sale; |
| Organisational characteristics | There is still a large number of spreadsheets, mainstream social tool sets, paper files and duplicate entries; |
| Organisational characteristics | Existing ERPs are heavier or do not cover non-target processes. |
| HF problems | Material, inventory and after-sale work orders cannot be linked in real time; |
| HF problems | (a) Unsatisfactory sales forecasts, procurement plans and financial returns; |
| HF problems | A manual summary of the statements is required for decision-making; |
| HF problems | Business is changing fast and traditional development is not keeping pace. |
| Reasons for purchase | Visualizing configuration quickly adapts non-standardized processes; |
| Reasons for purchase | Harmonized data base to reduce inter-system moves; |
| Reasons for purchase | AI Forecasting, asking questions and automation bring visible efficiency gains; |
| Reasons for purchase | This can be done from the CRM, procurement or inventory points. |
| Evidence trail. | Kuailu's public ProAvanti medical equipment case covers cross-regional sales, procurement, administration, technical support, installation maintenance and multi-SKU inventories, with the CRM/EMS/WMS integration solution. |
| Evidence trail. | [Source: ProAvanti Case] |

#### Type B: Trade, cross-border and multi-regional enterprises

| Classification of information | Specific content |
| --- | --- |
| Organisational characteristics | Collaboration between headquarters and branches/offices across regions; |
| Organisational characteristics | Multilingual, multi-temporal zones with long distribution, procurement, orders and delivery chains; |
| Organisational characteristics | Customers, quotations, contracts, logistics and post-sale information are scattered. |
| HF problems | Poor regional team information; |
| HF problems | (a) Inconsistencies in external document formats such as quotations, POs, PIs, contracts; |
| HF problems | (b) Inadequate follow-up to the proceedings and mandates of the cross-language meetings; |
| HF problems | Communication is unstable in an overseas or weak web environment. |
| Reasons for purchase | Multilingualism and cross-regional collaboration; |
| Reasons for purchase | Standardized documents and harmonized client views; |
| Reasons for purchase | A narrowband of high-resolution, AI subtitles and minutes of meetings; |
| Reasons for purchase | Hong Kong collaborates with the Mainland, privatization deployment and compliance support. |

#### Type C: Strongly regulated or secure organizations

| Classification of information | Specific content |
| --- | --- |
| Organisational characteristics | (a) Financial, medical, State-owned, professional or sensitive business data; |
| Organisational characteristics | (b) Local deployment, audit, letter creation, data retention and fine-particle authorization requirements; |
| Organisational characteristics | Several traditional systems may already exist. |
| HF problems | (b) Undefined data boundaries for public cloud meetings or generic AI; |
| HF problems | There is no secure sharing of data between systems; |
| HF problems | AI Insufficient competence, responsibility and traceability of results. |
| Reasons for purchase | Privatization deployment, business control data, logs and competencies; |
| Reasons for purchase | AI Integration with own knowledge/business data; |
| Reasons for purchase | It can be integrated with established systems and avoid one-time replacement. |
| Reasons for purchase | The Kuailu Meeting privacy policy states that the product supports cloud or local deployment and that Kuailu does not collect, view or save data when the enterprise has its own server stored; |
| Reasons for purchase | It also collects information needed for connection, equipment, recording, recording, etc. to deliver services. |
| Reasons for purchase | Further verification of data-processing protocols, model call chains, cross-border transmission, logs, backup and removal mechanisms is still required in real procurement. |
| Reasons for purchase | [Source: Kuailu Meeting Privacy Policy] (https://meetings.quickegret.com/user/privacy-new) |

#### Type D: digitized start-up SMEs

| Classification of information | Specific content |
| --- | --- |
| Organisational characteristics | 10-100 persons, the owner directly involved in the procurement; |
| Organisational characteristics | IT has few or no full-time IT personnel; |
| Organisational characteristics | (b) budget sensitive and fast-tracked; |
| Organisational characteristics | Demand is concentrated on standard modules such as write-offs, CRMs, approvals, finance, personnel, etc. |
| Reasons for purchase | Annual fees are manageable; |
| Reasons for purchase | (a) Templates are open for use; |
| Reasons for purchase | Visualisation reduces customization dependency; |
| Reasons for purchase | Free trial to reduce the risk of initial decision-making. |
